{{Top|leg}}
'''Recon Log 129873.2183''' was a report made by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Recon Mission D812]] leader [[Mils Gessak]]. It detailed the discovery of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] suitable for building a base inside, with Gessak's recommendation being to take possession of the rock. The base would become known as [[The Shattered Rock]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
